summary.headline: Bologna Codex: Astronomical Notes
summary.text: Catalog of Bologna codex folios 322v–339, listing painted portraits, lunar and zodiacal prognostications attributed to Eudoxus and Ptolemy, a Chaldean dodecaeteris, Arab star names, a Brontologium and Seismologion, planetary and astronomical notes, Kalantologion, zodiac tables, and Selenodromion. Later folios treat celestial and terrestrial phenomena including the elements, eclipses, heaven, earth, paradise, earthquakes, seas, ocean, clouds, thunder, lightning, and comets.
